chapter: Records, Lovie Austin and a first marriage
title: Lovie at the Monogram Theater; where Hunter recorded
summary: Lovie played piano at the packed Monogram vaudeville house; Hunter's Paramount sessions were mostly in New York, with a couple with Lovie in Chicago in 1923, including her own "Experience Blues".

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: But she was -- I mean she was the music director, wasn't she, of the Monogram Theater?
Monogram --
Small theater, wasn't it?

Yeah, very small but packed to capacity at all times, and they did nine and ten shows, and each house was packed. Now, she would -- this -- had this little funny upright piano sitting down, and she'd look up at the people. That's the way she'd do when she would -- it was a vaudeville -- little vaudeville house, you know.

And the people would come out and she'd start the numbers, and she'd start playing and never missed a note, you know, and -- let me see, did Lovie -- not only the Monogram. Didn't she play someplace else?
She was also the music director, I think, at the Paramount --
At the Grand, wasn't she?
-- Paramount records.
(Simultaneous remarks)
-- the house band there.
But this was long -- this was before.
Oh, you're talking about before the '20's.

No, this was the -- the Monogram was the '20's. But I don't remember whether she directed my -- no, she didn't direct my recordings, because they always sent me to New York, to the New York recording laboratory.
Oh, you --
Uh-huh, they would send me from Chicago to New York each time. If I'm not mistaken now, maybe I did -- I don't remember having recorded in Chicago, but maybe I did.
Well, most of yours, you did one with Lovie Austin and Jimmy O'Brian in 1923 --
I did?
Miss Anna Brown and Maybe Someday.
Ye-e-s.
And you also did another one with Lovie in Experience Blues and --
That was mine. I wrote that.
(Simultaneous remarks)
-- Blues -- yeah?
'Experience Blues', that's mine.
So you did those in Chicago.
In Chicago.
And the rest all seem to be done in New York.
In New York because --
